parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-resource-execution-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --execution-id exec-xxxxxxxxxxxx --max-results 50 --next-token MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ --region cn-hangzhou
